status: Pre-outcome design; projections are feasibility targets, not measured effects. Freeze before the one-fold audit. Historical TRAIN was previously pooled and the two published maps came from that pool; no pristine confirmation claim.
question: At beta=3.05, does either of the previously frozen four-symbol labels make independently prepared, inventory-matched 2x2x2 interiors more interchangeable? Which label leaves less unrelaxed interface mismatch?
selection: Only staged native TRAIN b09 and b00 (beta zero numerical null). Positions [0,256) per temperature for frequency-only support calibration; separate dev [4096,4608) cold and [256,512) hot. Single audit [4608,5120) cold only, after explicit release. Nothing from TEST, validation, reserves, index 6, trajectories or MCMC. No other inventory set, map, temperature or subgroup search.
geometry: All 8000 registered periodic translations of offsets (z,y,x) in {0,1}^3 in lexicographic order; digit zero at (0,0,0), x fastest, little-endian base 3 (0 vacancy, 1 A, 2 B). Distinct parent halves; orientation fixed; independent uniform translations using the full cross-product, never same-parent pairs.
maps: results/l20-autoresearch/faces/optimized.npz, sha256 ec838a3eb8e3b033ff980d38b91176404f81417969284feebff407ca76dc96c1; keys discrete_lut (optimized) and affine_lut. Baseline inventory (nA,nB) only.
work: W for an exchange of two interiors, in native energy units, no construction of a hybrid. H=sum_i occupied_i*(nearest_occupied_i-ideal_species_i)^2, ideal A=3, B=5. Each corner i has 3 inward and 3 outward neighbors. Each of the 24 exterior owner sites j is adjacent to exactly one interior site i. Interior coefficients U_i=(o_i,2o_i*(d_in_i-ideal_i)); exterior coefficients X_i=(d_out_i^2+sum_{j near i,outside} o_j*(2*(d_j excluding i-ideal_j)+1),d_out_i). Up to pure-interior and pure-exterior terms H=U.X. Therefore W=(U1-U2).(X2-X1). Re-exchange with exteriors interchanged flips sign; identical interior or identical exterior gives zero. Check against independently expanded 8+24 owner-square energies on native development pairs without materializing hybrids.
estimator: Independent consecutive blocks of 32 parents, split first vs last 16. For each inventory or inventory+label stratum take the complete two-sample U (all cross-half translations) by factorized dot-products of stratum sums. Combine stratum means with one-parent frequencies (pooled ordinary counts across both halves, never pair count weights), renormalized on the COMMON inventory support for all three arms. Preserve each parent plus every anchor in a single block. Report per-block work, pair denominators, support mass and intervals. Prior to measuring work, fix per-temperature inventories with at least 4 observations of every LUT-theoretically possible stratum, separately for both maps and every one of the 16 independent 16-parent calibration halves. If a retained inventory has an empty stratum on either half in a scored block exclude that entire inventory in ALL arms there and disclose. Common supported one-parent mass >=0.90 in EVERY block required for a verdict. No work-based or label-cell trimming.
decision: Signed paired gains positive for reduced work: Gopt=W0-Wopt, Gaff=W0-Waff, Gvs=Waff-Wopt. Predeclared material threshold 5% of inventory-only cold W0 for each. Analyze paired block contrasts G-0.05*W0 and G independently (no borrowing hot baseline), with two-sided Bonferroni Student-t intervals at 1-0.05/3 over the three contrasts, approximate independent-block inference. Significant if the interval for G excludes 0; material if lower endpoint of G-0.05*W0>0, materially excluded if upper endpoint<0, else unresolved. Also report ordinary 95% intervals for work in each arm; standardized ratios descriptive. Hot means test identity E[W]=0 with simultaneous three-arm intervals. No net-causal, surface tension, cavity, relaxation or phase claim.
projection: Cold dev and audit each 16 disjoint blocks of 32 whole parents; hot dev 8 such blocks. Each block has 256000 anchors, 16384000000 unconditional cross-half anchor pairs before matching (NOT independent replicates). With 16 blocks, approximate 80%-power detectable increment over the specified threshold is (t_(15,1-0.05/6)+0.842)*SD_block/4. Report this uncertainty projection in cold dev before any release. If support or precision fails, keep the endpoint and report the limit.
identity: Within inventory and, if applicable, an interior-only label, P(u,x) is the canonical conditional joint law and R=P_U P_X. Both have the same marginals. The canonical log density is -beta H plus a stratum constant on a Cartesian support (fixed interior inventory). Thus beta E[W]=2 beta (E_R H-E_P H)=2*(D(P||R)+D(R||P)); nonnegative in population, but not necessarily decreasing upon label matching. At beta=0 uniform independent interior/exterior within inventory remains independent after conditioning on its interior label: E[W]=0. Do not infer the two KL components separately or divide by beta at zero.
